metaDescription: Siberian vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Siberian boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Siberian owners tracking 11-15 years lifespans still lose the mid-series booster more often than the first shot, and the unprotected gap after week 8 is where panleukopenia risk concentrates for this kitten.
Use the 4-row Siberian schedule as your only planning spine: 8 weeks (FVRCP); 12 weeks (FVRCP booster); 16 weeks (FVRCP booster); 16 weeks (Rabies).

Temperament note for Siberian handling: Forest cat type; HCM screening; often marketed for allergy households (verify individually).. Schedule quieter appointment slots if that profile makes clinic visits harder, but do not skip the Siberian dose.
Lifestyle add-ons stay off this Siberian core list until your veterinarian maps exposure, so keep core dates sacred either way.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Siberian shots when the kitten seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (hcm) risk worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Siberian make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Siberian antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Siberian dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this large cat.
Reset the Siberian reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Siberian core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Siberian misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Siberian health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Siberian adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (hcm) risk, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
